accessibility.contrast_check: Ensure 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Use slate-900 on white.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Do not build a generic template. This is a PRO tool. Think 'Swiss Sport Watch' precision. Use the provided fonts. Use white space aggressively.
instructions_to_main_agent.landing_page: Use the 'Tetris' grid. Hero section must be bold with the track runner image. Use the 'dot_grid' texture in the background of feature sections.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard: Use the 'Bento' grid. Dense but organized. No rounded corners greater than 'rounded-xl'. Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all data labels and metrics.
instructions_to_main_agent.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Colors: Blue for progress, Lime for success/peaks, Slate for baseline.
instructions_to_main_agent.navigation: Sidebar for dashboard, Sticky glass header for landing.

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠 etc.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
